behavioralNotes: Replaced card-stack layout with refined map-first composition and sidebar controls adhering to Marcelo aesthetic.
Integrated original generated architectural artwork in public/artworks/chat12-cartography-plinth.webp.
Enforced Nest.js global /api/places prefix and resilient response validation in lib/redesign-chat12-scan.ts.
Distinguished loading, free, available, and unavailable pricing without false zero defaults.
Diagnosed W3C geolocation errors (permission denied, position unavailable, timeout) in AR and EN.
Implemented accessible modal dialogs with focus traps, escape key handling, and aria attributes.
Enabled client-side RFC 4180 CSV export with UTF-8 BOM encoding for Arabic compatibility.
Maintained read-only status for shared Map and PaymentMethodsModal components.
